ai_summary: Aarti Pharmalabs reported robust financial performance for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, showcasing significant year-over-year growth in both revenue and net profit. However, auditors highlighted a substantial contingent liability of Rs. 5,746 lakhs related to disputed stamp duty and penalties on a past demerger, currently under legal challenge, alongside a prior period restatement due to a fair value loss on a target redemption forward contract. Additionally, the company announced the routine resignation of its CFO, with a qualified replacement appointed.
